name: gae
one_liner: Gamify Any Environment. A Rust + Bevy engine kit and agent playbook that turns any work domain (blue team, red team, programming, ops) into a live, GPU-rendered constellation like Agent Globe.

commands.release: cargo build --release -p soc-desk && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/gae | Out-Null; Copy-Item target/release/soc-desk.exe $env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/gae/soc-desk.exe -Force"
